searchText: 512 near-head trie logs is ~100-150MiB. I calculate 3 weeks to be 151,200 blocks and so non-finality trie log diffs size would be ~30-50GiB by my estimate This is for Besu's "state diff" files? Much bigger than I expected for 512 blocks worth of just state diffs? I've not looked at it deeply, but might be a lot we could do to reduce that...it's not really been necessary to have them as small as possible yet since they are a small % of total full node db size. Might be some rocksdb related overhead in there too. Is each block traced distinctly? Could we keep n*32 blocks of logs such that replay from an over-rollback is not excessive? I expect if we "collapse" the logs into multi-block diffs the size gets much more reasonable. <@277500722655002624> the discussion here may also be relevant to your question on RLNC
